def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, sat
    
    s = Solver()
    
    curr_dev = Int('curr_dev')
    curr_net = Int('curr_net')
    sublist = Int('sublist')
    dev = Int('dev')
    net = Int('net')
    skb = Int('skb')
    
    # Line 5-6: curr_dev = NULL, curr_net = NULL (initialization)
    s.add(curr_dev == 0)
    s.add(curr_net == 0)
    
    # Line 8: INIT_LIST_HEAD(&sublist) - sublist initialized as empty
    s.add(sublist == 0)
    
    # Line 10: dev = skb->dev - valid skb implies valid dev pointer
    s.add(dev != 0)
    
    # Line 11: net = dev_net(dev) - kernel guarantees non-NULL net for valid dev
    s.add(net != 0)
    
    # Line 15-16: if (skb == NULL) continue - path constraint to reach line 18
    s.add(skb != 0)
    
    # Line 18: condition (curr_dev != dev || curr_net != net) evaluates TRUE on first iteration
    s.add(curr_dev != dev)
    
    # Line 20: !list_empty(&sublist) - on first iteration sublist is empty
    s.add(sublist == 0)
    
    # Line 24-25: after branch, curr_dev and curr_net are updated
    s.add(curr_dev == dev)
    s.add(curr_net == net)
    
    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
